figurative_meaning_en: A family distinguished by many relatives or a large extended family
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই গ্রামের সবচেয়ে যদুবংশের মতো পরিবারটি।
example_sentences_in_english: Their family is as vast as the Yadava dynasty.
This village's largest family resembles the Yadava lineage.
history: Refers to the Yadava dynasty in Hindu mythology, the lineage of Lord Krishna from the Mahabharata and Puranas, symbolizing a prominent and populous clan.
note: This idiom draws from ancient Indian epics, often used metaphorically in Bengali literature to denote grandeur in family size.
